text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *cough*... *cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...
Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Even though I made it into the race.
Even though I promised...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, everyone.
Big Sis..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I... ngh...
(Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Vivlos!
And... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for working so hard.
For showing us such a wonderful run...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure
you'll be just fine."

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. Vivlos worked so hard for us,
after all."

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for showing me such an incredible dream!!
I'll be cheering for you in your next race too!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: The Tiara route is still going! Great job, Vivlos~~!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
If you win even just one crown,
it'll be your revenge!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right.
I can still avenge Big Sis...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks", "The Shuka Sho"...
—I want to win them!
Though Vivlos was completely drained right after the race, after a little time had passed—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I feel even better than before the race!
I could totally run another one!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh.
I mean, I'm feeling super great, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"All my tiredness is totally gone now!
I could even train right now, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I gotta get
my revenge too!

She seems to feel nothing right now due to the excitement of the race...
but letting herself get swept up in it is dangerous.
choice_data_list: Let's rest a bit more before we head out.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Trainy, are you being a bit of a worrywart?
choice_data_list: You're what matters most to me.
You are what's most important to me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh!?
choice_data_list: Make sure to get plenty of rest before the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's what you meant... of course...
Phew, you scared me."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
understood!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of your precious, preeeecious me,
I'm gonna get plenty of rest today, Trainie♡

Our next target is the second crown of the Triple Tiara...
The Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Phone Sound
text_block_list.text:
"‘While the spotlighted Verxina's sister Vivlos failed
to avenge her, she delivered a promising performance.
She remains one to watch going forward—’"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...'Promising,' huh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ever since you were a child,
you've been able to do anything.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Unlike me—
